verdict.rationale: Greptile supports rule-based automation within the code-review domain: reviews trigger automatically on PR/commit events, teams can define custom standards/rules (greptile.json) that catch team-specific issues, and the platform can conditionally route reviews (e.g., routing agent-authored PRs to a different model). This is genuine event-triggered, rule-driven automation, but it's scoped to code review actions rather than a general-purpose 'if event then any action' automation engine spanning arbitrary triggers/actions. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined arbitrary trigger conditions beyond PR/commit events, and support for chaining custom actions outside the review/fix workflow.
